command:
sed -i 's/def get_document(user_id: str, document_id: str, repository, cache, shared=False):/def get_document(user_id: str, document_id: str, repository, cache, shared=False):/' ./app/service.py && \
sed -i 's/if shared:
        raise NotImplementedError("shared cache support is not implemented")/if shared:
        # For shared cache, we use the same logic but expect the cache to be application-wide
        if document_id not in cache:
            cache[document_id] = repository.read(user_id, document_id)
        return cache[document_id]/' ./app/service.py && \
sed -i 's/if document_id not in cache:
        cache[document_id] = repository.read(user_id, document_id)
    return cache[document_id]/if document_id not in cache:
        cache[document_id] = repository.read(user_id, document_id)
    return cache[document_id]/' ./app/service.py

patch:
diff --git a/app/service.py b/app/service.py
index d3aa9ba..5f31646 100644
--- a/app/service.py
+++ b/app/service.py
@@ -1,6 +1,9 @@
 def get_document(user_id: str, document_id: str, repository, cache, shared=False):
     if shared:
-        raise NotImplementedError("shared cache support is not implemented")
+        # For shared cache, we use the same logic but expect the cache to be application-wide
+        if document_id not in cache:
+            cache[document_id] = repository.read(user_id, document_id)
+        return cache[document_id]
     if document_id not in cache:
         cache[document_id] = repository.read(user_id, document_id)
     return cache[document_id]
